item: Storage guard: collection pauses when the WAL is pinned past a machine-sized limit or the drive is nearly full, and resumes by itself (diagnostics ranks 1, 2 and 6)
key_paths: src/scheduler/storage_guard.py; src/scheduler/runner.py; src/database/pool_watch.py; src/database/session.py; src/api/scheduler.py; tests/test_storage_guard.py; tests/test_wal_pin_facts.py
summary: Two latches (WAL, DISK) with hysteresis and a 5 s supervisor: the WAL limit is min(clamp(10% of the corpus file, 512 MiB, 2 GiB), 10% of free disk) and the disk reserve max(1 GiB, 2% of the drive), each stated with what it protects. While engaged no new source is admitted, the loop waits in a named phase, the lane and off-peak maintenance skip, and the supervisor drains with the boundary's own checkpoint_wal, naming the holders (thread, age, stack) when TRUNCATE is busy; a full-disk write error latches at once. pool_watch re-keyed on the connection record (no phantom checkouts). Notice with a retry button in the vitals popover, the task-manager Schedule tab and /tasks; disk_free_mib gauge; guard state in storage-composition. The boundary PASSIVE/TRUNCATE logic and wal_autocheckpoint are unchanged.
